aside.text: If you're being verified through StarOrigin, you'll always know what is being checked and why. You can ask about your data at any time.

items.question: Do you need the candidate's consent?
items.answer: Yes, always. Every check begins with a clear notice to the candidate and their written consent. We do not run checks without it.

items.question: Can I order verification for candidates you didn't place?
items.answer: Yes. Background verification is available as a standalone service for any of your hires.

items.question: What causes delays?
items.answer: Most delays come from slow responses by previous employers or institutions. We follow up regularly and flag any check that is running late.

items.question: What happens if a discrepancy is found?
items.answer: We report the facts we found, with supporting notes. Decisions on next steps rest with you, and we recommend giving the candidate a chance to explain.

items.answer: Yes, through our presence in the UAE and US, subject to local laws on which checks are permitted.
